title: Beijinho
description: Beijinho is a dish from Brazil featuring sweetened condensed milk, desiccated coconut. This home-sized recipe records each ingredient at the step where it is used.

steps.instruction: Simmer the liquid and flavorings uncovered for about 15 minutes until reduced and concentrated.
Refrigerate the prepared mixture for about 45 minutes, cooling perishable foods promptly and never holding cooked rice warm at room temperature.
Shape, press or roll the prepared dough or mixture into portions appropriate to this dish.
Roll the cooled coconut-condensed-milk mixture into bite-sized sweets and coat with sugar; keep refrigerated.
